known_secrets.text: The river's channel is still slowly drifting, even generations after the Turning.
Two upper terraces flood unevenly compared to twenty years ago.
Old boundary stones no longer match the current terrace lines.
Doran has quietly moved his sowing dates earlier without informing the Assembly formally.
Some low terraces near the Old Canal Bed have been unproductive for years, farmed out of stubbornness.

unknowns: Meaning of the Signs on the seals
